statement: Passing these tests establishes software behaviour only. It establishes nothing about measurement accuracy or clinical meaning.

tests.name: same seed and answers: identical trial sequence, stimulus parameters, geometry, ladder and scores in rc10 and current engines
stimulus pixels: drawGrating output is byte-identical in rc10 and current engines (dpr 1 and 2, all columns, rows, tilts)
guidance, report text, data file and integrity payload identical for a phone-edition record (only the software stamp may differ)
PDF wording: every word of the rc10 report appears in the same order in the new layout, with standard and embedded fonts
healthy-pattern run: tier none, computed at finalise, outside the integrity scope
easy-patch rule: two or more misses in rows 1–3 of A–C in one eye → worth an eye check; names the patches
unreliable conditions downgrade an eye-check to repeat, and say why
between the eyes: first time → repeat; reproduced in the previous run → eye check
against own baseline: a two-step drop in two columns after two baseline runs → changed since your baseline
context never changes the tier; exploratory rows never count; wording carries no result labels
mirrored Left/Right answers (e.g. a reversed button icon) give repeat to confirm, never an eye check
density table: every entry complete; exact lookups for listed models; class fallback otherwise
iris distance: synthetic landmarks recover distance within 5 %; missing face gives null; calibration solves the focal length
drift rule: more than 15 % change flags drift; summaries are medians with SD
stimulus self-check: the grating maths yields the nominal cycles per degree and tilt at three phone densities
questionnaire: twelve items validated and stored in context; scoring and integrity ignore it
report: context section after section 7 only for runs with a context block; "What you told us" only when answered; result labels still absent
evidence page: every [n] citation has a reference and every reference is cited
pages: internal links resolve to built files; scope statement present; no result labels used as claims
phone edition and pages load nothing from third-party origins; vendored files match VENDOR.md checksums
terms and privacy: draft status, versions, urgent-care advice, adults only, ACL not excluded, camera and health information explained
answer-button icons lean the same way as the stimulus they name (desktop and phone)
design tokens: every text colour pairing meets WCAG 2.2 AA (4.5:1) in light and dark themes
state machine: submitAnswer is a no-op outside ARMED; ARMED only entered by nextTrial; random sequences never duplicate n
full run: 90 presented trials, contiguous n, typed fields
quick mode: after two consecutive misses the rest of the column is not presented, nulls, reason quick-stop
scoring counts over presented only; v1 rule reproduced; rows-1-to-6 variant ignores rows 7-9
isolated flag: correct 1-4, miss 5-6, correct 7, miss 8-9
interocular log10 difference and null handling
integrity scope: definition+responses change the hash; scoring/validation/timestamps/status do not; canonical form
finaliseRun is idempotent: three concurrent calls, one write, same promise
storage failure gives COMPLETE_UNSAVED and keeps the record exportable
crypto.subtle absent: hash null, hashError set, record still saved
interrupted run: draft after every trial, INCOMPLETE export with no scoring, no report
ladder: computed code amplitudes and exploratory flags
storage limit: warning at 80, stop saving at 100, nothing deleted
legacy vcs-history untouched by a run
forbidden result labels absent from report text and SVG
reference curve hidden unless SHOW_REFERENCE_CURVE
chart marks: hollow not-presented, red can't-see without tail, isolated ring, band and dashed line
sampling sentence bands; never "accurate"
identification block: heading, versions, build target, integrity wording, validation statuses
safeguard 1: a build without passing results, or with results for another source hash, never claims passed tests
export round-trip and re-score leave the hash unchanged
safeguard 2: full and quick both finalise, including quick runs whose final scheduled trials are skipped
safeguard 4: report counts and wording follow the actual protocol and trials
fixture reports: three PDFs build and carry section 5 wording for each case
rollback: v0.6.0 source still builds its sample report from the v0.6.0 fixture (file-level check)
two pointerup events within 100 ms record one trial
ArrowLeft then ArrowRight within 100 ms, and held key repeats, record one trial
touch tap and mouse click from different pointers within 50 ms record one trial
inputs during LOCKED/BLANK are ignored (default 250 ms blank)
zoom/DPR change during a run is recorded and reported
staging isolation: build target, banner, separate storage keys, live build reads neither
storage limit in the browser: 100 records → run ends COMPLETE_UNSAVED, prominent notice, export-all offered, nothing deleted
storage disabled: COMPLETE_UNSAVED with immediate export and beforeunload warning
interrupted run: reload mid-test shows banner; export is INCOMPLETE; discard clears; no report path
legacy vcs-history byte-identical after a run; shown read-only
results view: heading, no forbidden labels, PDF download works
swipe recognition: −45/0/+45 and ±14° map to left/up/up/right; 20 px swipe ignored; two swipes in the blank record one trial
camera refused: typed distance path, distanceSource typed, section 2 says entered
trial screen has no white element; patch is 5° at the recorded distance within 2 %
a complete swiped quick run: questionnaire stored outside the hash, integrity recomputes, PDF and JSON export, record saved
manifest valid and service worker registers and caches the shell
first test asks for the three acknowledgements; continue is disabled until all are ticked; the acceptance is recorded on the run
face model loads from our own origin with a camera present; the page makes no third-party requests
test screen: same seeded trials show byte-identical stimulus canvases and identical screenshots of the grey field in rc10 and the redesign
test screen: field and surround are rgb(128, 128, 128); no filter, opacity, blend, transform, backdrop or animation on the stimulus or its ancestors
